A '''battle''' was fought on [[Khar Shian]]<ref name="Legacy Reborn" /> around [[3622 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> between the [[Hidden Chain]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Eternal Alliance]], and the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Prelude==
===Jadus and the Hidden Chain===
[[File:Khar Shian Fleet.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Hidden Chain fleet orbiting Khar Shian]]
Following the [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']] [[Mission to the Enigma|incident]], [[Heta Kol]] and [[Darth Jadus]] arrived on Khar Shian with the full strength of their forces to activate [[Darth Nul]]'s machine, which had been constructed deep within [[Naga Sadow's fortress]]. The [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] was the only structure capable of housing the machine and surviving the strain of its activation.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

[[File:Heta and Jadus.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Jadus, Heta Kol, and their forces assembled]]
As they looked on, [[Darth Rivix]] carefully placed [[Darth Nul's holocron]] into its designated position within the machine. Growing impatient, Heta Kol angrily urged Jadus to activate the machine before anything could interrupt their plans. Jadus, however, sharply rebuked her, stating that the machine was far too sophisticated to be treated like one of the Hidden Chain's improvised creations. He insisted that it be tested first before any full activation attempt. To carry out the test, Jadus ordered that [[Sa'har Kateen|the Padawan]] be brought forward from among their four prisoners, who also included a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and [[Tau Idair]]. In response, Heta signaled [[Ri'kan Kateen]] to bring the Padawan before them to which Tau attempted to resist but Rivix activated her shock collar and demanded no more outbursts as she should be relieved that she isn't dead after her attempted rescue effort.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

[[File:Sahar pleads Rikan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sa'har tries to reason with her brother]]
Ri'kan hesitated at first, visibly reluctant to comply. However, after a sharp demand from Heta, he moved forward and lifted the shackled Sa'har. Desperate, Sa'har pleaded with her brother not to allow them to activate the machine. Her protests were ignored. At Rivix's insistence, Jadus' acolytes used the Force to pull her from Ri'kan's grasp and secure her upon the machine's throne. As Sa'har was restrained in place, Jadus addressed her, telling her that she should be proud. He declared that, just as she had on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], she would soon help free countless others from what he described as the Jedi's destructive arrogance. With those words spoken, Rivix proceeded to activate the machine.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

[[File:Nul Machine Activated.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Nul's machine is activated for testing]]
As Nul's machine activated, a small energy field formed around its central structure. Moments later, two massive rings emerged from the ground, bathed in blue light, and began rotating vertically around the machine. Their movement flooded the surrounding chamber with an intense blue glow, casting shifting shadows across the fortress. Observing the process, Darth Jadus ordered that more power be directed into the machine. The increase immediately took its toll on Sa'har, causing her visible pain as the machine drew upon her connection to the Force. Unsatisfied with the results, Jadus demanded an even greater surge of power. The machine responded with a violent discharge of energy, enveloping Sa'har in crackling arcs of lightning. She cried out in agony as the torrent coursed through her body, inflicting immense suffering. The sight visibly shook Ri'kan, who could no longer remain silent. Disturbed by what he was witnessing, he turned to Heta and protested, insisting that they had gone too far and that this was too much.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

[[File:Rikan tries to free Sahar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ri'kan tries to free Sa'har]]
Ri'kan berated his Field Marshal, questioning why she was following a Sith after previously denouncing them as slavers, dishonorable, and untrustworthy. Heta responded by striking Ri'kan and ordering him to be silent and step back, prompting a Hidden Chain soldier to draw a weapon on him. Unable to endure Sa'har's screams of pain any longer, Ri'kan, renounced Heta and her cause, attacked the soldier, seized his weapon, and attempted to free his sister while fighting his way past Jadus' acolytes. When confronted by four of Jadus' Sith, Ri'kan unleashed a rage-fueled Force attack that rendered them unconscious and damaged the machine to the point that it ceased functioning, freeing Sa'har from its grasp. Recovering quickly, Heta Kol attacked Ri'kan, but he initially gained the upper hand and knocked her aside before reaching Sa'har. 

[[File:Tau fights back.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tau breaks free and retaliates]]
Tau also managed to free herself, seize a nearby Sith's lightsaber, and hold off the remaining acolytes in the chamber. As Ri'kan attempted to reach his sister, Rivix struck him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], though he was soon distracted when Tau damaged the machine's console. Sa'har, wanting to help her friend, was told by Tau to escape while she held off the Sith pursuers. Grief-stricken, she reluctantly complied and left with Ri'kan who were then further pursued by a Hidden Chain squad led by [[Shauz Farr]].<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

===Shae and Malgus===
[[File:Malgus abandons Shae.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Malgus abandons Shae and her cause]]
Meanwhile, prior to the machine's activation, [[Darth Malgus]], [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], and [[Mandalore the Avenger's crew|their team]] arrived on [[Khar Shian]] aboard a [[Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttle|''Scorpion''-class Intercept Shuttle]] that had successfully passed through the shield surrounding the fortress. As Malgus approached Shae, he remarked that they would finally bring an end to the conflict. However, after hearing strange voices, he abruptly made his way toward the shuttle's exit. When Shae questioned his actions, Malgus stated that there were enemies far more dangerous than Heta Kol and declared that the Field Marshal was no longer his concern, but Shae's. Abandoning his former ally in mid-mission, Malgus departed on his own. Angered by his decision, Shae declared that she and her team were on their own.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

===The Alliance===
The [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Arn Peralun]] returned to [[Odessen]] to find a Republic fleet where [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Barus Rava]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sal-Deron]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]] waited for the duo. Upon landing on the flagship, Arn and the Commander found themselves surrounded by Republic soldiers, with [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Theron Shan]] also in custody, to which the Commander wanted to know the reason for this ordeal. Rava sternly replied  that they were asking the questions, and that they better receive answers or the Commander would be dragged back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in chains. Rans supported this decision and blamed it on the Commander's insubordination and subsequent meeting with [[Darth Jadus]], making them look complicit to which the Commander tried to set the record straight with Arn backing up the Commander. Lana interjected by saying that although this would impact the partnership between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Eternal Alliance]], for the moment they needed to deal with the critical situation at hand and sort out the details later. Rava rejected the suggestion and Rans backed him while ordering a trooper to arrest the Commander while the other troopers aimed their weapons at the ready. Sal-Deron demanded [[Darth Nul's holocron]] but seeing the Commander's expression she concluded that it was no longer in their possession. The trooper arrived with the cuffs, Lana protested, and the Commander warned the Republic's leaders to not do this now. Arn spoke up, protesting to Rans and reminding her how the Republic used to honor heroes who protected it, which he credited the Commander with doing, and that now the Republic acts differently where only one decided to stand against Jadus and his machinations and the only person who can stand against Jadus to which the Commander agrees on but get interrupted by an alarm.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

The fleet of the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] arrives, commanded by [[Arbiter (Mandalorians)|Arbiter]] [[Jekiah Ordo]] on the flagship the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', surprising the Republic contingent to which the Commander adds that they will need the help of the Mandalorians. Then Jekiah, [[Rass Ordo]], [[Lane Vizla]], and four [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] jetpack into the flagship hangar ready to back up the Commander as Jekiah mentions they mobilized as soon as Lana alerted them. Rans tells Jekiah that the Commander is in serious trouble and that they are on their own and Jekiah replies that Mandalorians don't turn their backs on friends and gives an ultimatum: the Republic can accept the help of the other two powers against the Hidden Chain and Darth Jadus or they can stop the Commander and add more enemies to their growing list to which the Commander emphasizes their importance in the coming conflict and what would happen if they weren't there to which Arn pleads with Rans to listen to reason. General Daerun joins Arn and the Commander saying that they haven't steered the Republic cause in the wrong direction yet. Rava disapproves, Sal-Deron says that they need to stop Nul's machine from activating to which Rans relents and says that they would now need a plan and heads to the briefing room.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

In the meeting, the Commander retells his encounter with Jadus as well as [[Tau Idair]] and that they encountered Nul's personality matrix that told them Khar Shian was the next suitable planet, after Elom, for the machine to be placed for maximum effect to which Jekiah backs up the claim from the intel he received from the Hidden Chain defector which stated that the Hidden Chain were moving supplies and equipment through Sith space at the scale of building something big. Sal-Deron interjects to say that Khar Shian is not a feasible place to build the machine and Arn adds that the only structure capable of holding the machine is [[Naga Sadow's fortress]]. Daerun expresses their lack of preparation for the coming battle especially since the majority of their forces are occupied with the [[Attack on Vinsoth|Imperial attack]] on [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] and that they won't be getting reinforcements. Jekiah adds that they have scouts patrolling the sector that can find the fortress' exact location and once they had it then the Mandalorians will launch a ground assault against the Hidden Chain as a divergence while a smaller team can enter the fortress to search for Jadus. The Commander will lead the team with Lana and Theron volunteering and Daerun says that the fleets will cover the team's approach. Rava protests Daerun as a general giving orders to his fleet but then Rans overrules his authority and gives the Commander a homing beacon to place on the machine so it can be targeted for destruction. With the plan solidified, the commanders are notified that the fleet is approaching Khar Shian while Jekiah receives a confirmation on the fortress' exact location with a lot of Hidden Chain around it.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

==Battle==
The Republic and Mandalorian fleet exited hyperspace and immediately faced-off against the Hidden Chain fleet above the moon, starting with the Republic opening fire followed by the Mandalorians, thus beginning the battle. The strike team traveled to the moon's surface on a captured Hidden Chain [[Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttle|''Scorpion''-class Intercept Shuttle]] followed by three Trat'ade shuttles. However, the fortress' energy shields destroyed two Trat'ade shuttles that attempted to pass through, forcing the third to pull up. Fortunately, the Hidden Chain shuttle was authorized to enter and cleared for landing. General Daeruun and Arn Peralun joined the space battle in [[Gatalentan Dawn|a BT-7 ''Thunderclap'']], leading attack runs on Hidden Chain capital ships. However, more Hidden Chain ships emerged from hyperspace behind the Republic fleet, destroying one [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class]] and one [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class]]. Rans ordered Daeruun to fall back and rally the smaller ships while using the larger corvettes for cover. One of the Hidden Chain capital ships was revealed to have an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] equipped, which swiftly disabled the cruiser [[Endurance (Valor-class)|''Endurance'']], forcing Rava to reposition the fleet around the disabled ship until its crew could reboot its systems.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

Upon arriving on a Hidden Chain landing site, Lana Beniko spotted [[Sa'har Kateen]] and [[Ri'kan Kateen]] exiting a tunnel in a panic and alerted their presence to Theron and the Commander who then opened fire on the nearby Hidden Chain soldiers, which announced their presence. This prompted a turbolaser battery to open fire on their ship, forcing the trio to exit the shuttle as it crashed. Just then, [[Shauz Farr]] and his soldiers engaged the strike team who defeated Farr's squad with the help of Sa'har. At Ri'kan's behest, Sa'har couldn't stay to help as she needed to be stay with her brother and get away from the Hidden Chain, Heta, Jadus, and Nul's holocron. The siblings boarded a nearby [[Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttle|''Scorpion''-class Intercept Shuttle]] and left Khar Shian.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

The Commander's team then proceeded into the tunnels in search of the shield controls, fighting past any Hidden Chain soldiers in their way. Upon reaching the control room, Shan sliced into the fortress' ancient computer systems. While its data was an disorganized mess, Shan was able to fashion a holographic map of the fortress, though he had no location on Nul's machine. He then detected two power spikes in the main systems. Beniko stated they should investigate those surges after taking down the shield so they may locate and destroy Nul's machine, but she did suggest the right person be allowed to use it, which Shan opposed, believing one person should not make such a decision for the entire galaxy, whether they like it or not. The Commander then received a call from Rass Ordo, warning that the Trat'ade forces wouldn't last long if the shields weren't taken down.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

The Commander's team continued to fight their way to the shield controls, only to discover a completely unorthodox setup, with a droid welded into place with multiple cables attached to it. When Shan tried to examine it, it suddenly came to life and attacked, forcing the trio to destroy it, and in so doing, caused the fortress' shield to vanish.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

The loss of the shield was felt in the area where Nul's machine. Spotting the machine starting to spark, Heta accused the soldiers who were repairing the power console of blundering. Seeing one of her men shrug, Heta tried raising [[Darz Varad|Darz]] for a report. Darz was able to report on the loss of the shield and the enemy siege, shortly before he was stabbed in the back by Shae Vizla's team. Using Darz's comm device, Shae told Heta she was coming for her. Ignoring the Hidden Chain leader's insults and threats, she ordered her team to kill any Hidden Chain in their path but to leave their leader for herself. Meanwhile, Heta briefly cursed in Mandalorian before spotting a [[Heta Kol's Sith sword|Sith blade]] on a nearby rack, with indistinct voices whispering to her, grasped it and marched off to find her rival.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

As her Sith allies watched her depart, they suddenly sensed a disturbance in the Force. Once Rivix confirmed the repairs and modifications to Nul's machine were almost complete, Jadus ordered him to depart to prepare for the next phase of his plan. Surprised by the order, Rivix tried to protest, but Jadus asserted that events were constantly in motion and advised him to trust that he had the vision to leverage them accordingly. Rivix then conceded to his Master's wishes and departed.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

With the shields down, the Trat'ade forces could land, sporting their new [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]], piloted by Jekiah, Rass and Lane, following their Arbiter's orders to finish the Hidden Chain once and for all. The Ordo brothers then proceeded to carve a path up to the fortress, destroying Hidden Chain wartanks and marking air defense turrets for orbital strikes. However, when they neared the fortress entrance, the enemy destroyed the bridge needed to access, forcing the brothers to find an alternative. Marching up the northern path, they spotted another opening and jetted in their Basilisks, only to find the chamber they landed in wasn't unoccupied, but filled four stasis chambers containing towering Sith monstrosities created by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] resembling [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]], one of which had broken out of his chamber. Speaking in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], the Sith monster moaned that he woke from one nightmare only to find another but vowed he had the power to destroy. After a prolonged battle, the Ordo brothers managed to kill the monstrosity, who asked with his dying breath if he was finally free. With the fortress' corridor being too narrow for the Basilisk, Rass ordered the droids to patrol the section. Jekiah ordered him to pass onto Lane to have their forces break through the front door and spread out to lock down the temple, before calling the Commander to inform their ally that they were going to search for Heta.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Meanwhile, the space battle was not going well for the Republic and Trat'ade fleets with the Hidden Chain's ion cannon giving them the advantage. Upon hearing Peralun's distress call, Shan brought up a holomap of the fortress and identified its ancient air defense. Unfortunately, the air defense control room was nowhere near the power spikes they had been tracking, so the trio had to split up, with Beniko and Shan going for the air defense array, while the Commander followed the power spikes. Fighting through Hidden Chain and Jadus troopers as well as disabling a series of ray shields in their way, the two found the cannon controls and targeting the Hidden Chain ship with the ion cannon, firing a chain shot that took out four enemy ships, turning the tide of the battle in the allied forces' favor. The force of the cannon was so powerful that it caused the fortress to tremble, nearly causing Heta to stumble, while the cannon controls fried themselves, shortly before Beniko and Shan were confronted by more Jadus troopers.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Elsewhere, the Commander came across Shae in a large antechamber, watching Mandalore kill several Hidden Chain soldiers single-handedly. She then took notice of the Commander, remarking she shouldn't be surprised to see her former ally. The Ordo brothers then appeared out of another corridor and confronted her for freeing Malgus and abandoning her people. In turn, Shae defended her actions, stating that she was putting an end to Heta Kol the only way she knew how. Jekiah put an end to Rass' tirade and calmly told Shae that her presence was a complication they didn't need, receiving a shocked reaction. As he reminded everyone to focus on their mission, Heta appeared. Speaking in a raspy voice, she thanked Shae for arriving and bringing all her allies in one place to eliminate so she could take her rightful place as Mandalore, with no need for any traps or meaningless pursuits. Shae retorted that Heta had gone against everything Mandalorians stand for in spite of claiming they had lost their way, wielding Sith weapons and bowing to their whims, the same tyrants who manipulated Mandalorians for decades, what her parents' clan rebelled against and died for. Heta arrogantly boasted she made the Sith's power her own and vowed to use it, and any weapon, to destroy her enemies.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Shae then charged at Heta and dived below her sword strike, shooting a device behind Heta and jetting out of the way as the explosion knocked the Field Marshal off her feet, activating an electrical field around the room, creating an arena. Recovering, Heta shouted, "''Mando'ade draar digu''", before engaging her opponents. With the sword in her hand glowing red, Heta attacked with powers she had never had before, summoning rock formations from the ground, energy blasts from the sword and encasing herself in crystal to rest mid-fight as her forces attacked in her place. Amidst Shae and Heta exchange of insults against one another, Jekiah tried to warn the Field Marshal that the room was reacting to both her sword and her corruption, but Heta proclaimed the room reacted to her power, the same power she would use to bring the Mandalorians to victory.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Losing her patience, Heta jumped up and slammed her weapon on the ground, causing a shockwave that resonated with the crystals around the arena, which soon unleashed a massive attack which shocked and paralysed the Mandalorians, leaving the Commander barely able to stand. As she approached them, they retaliated and with that, knocked her helmet off of her head. Shockingly, Heta's face had been grotesquely transformed, with multiple rock-like tumors around her now-pale face, her eyes glowing with the same glow as her blade's guard. Still recovering from the shock, the Commander was vulnerable as Heta approached them with her blade, ready to kill as she complimented her enemy for a fight well fought. Before she could strike them down however, Shae recovered and with her jetpack slammed Heta into a crystal, causing a massive electrical current to be sent through her body.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" /> 

[[File:Heta stabs Shae.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Heta fatally wounding Shae]]
Just as Shae raised her blaster, declaring their rivalry at an end, a defiant Heta managed to stab her through the stomach. In shock, Shae looked around and saw that Jekiah and the Commander were still recovering, and in an act of sacrifice, shoved herself and Heta at the crystal again. This time, she didn't release her grip and the current went through her body as well as Heta's. Groaning in pain, Heta begged her rival to stop, but Mandalore ignored her pleas, and after a moment Heta Kol stopped responding, electrocuted. As Shae let go, Heta's body hit the floor. As the glow from the blade started to disappear, the Hidden Chain's Field Marshal Heta Kol was dead.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

[[File:Shae kills Heta.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Shae victorious over Heta]]
With the deed done, Shae then collapsed from her injuries, with Jekiah catching her. As the Arbiter commended her victory, Shae concurred, but lamented that Malgus was right about Heta, but at least she took her down with her. Initially confused by her words, Jekiah realized her wounds were mortal and looked to Rass and the Commander, frantically asking when reinforcements could arrive or if anyone had a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]]. Shae called him a stubborn old [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] who didn't know how to give up. Jekiah remarked on the irony of her statement and begged her not to leave her people again. Shae then looked to Rass, getting him to promise to keep Jekiah from blaming himself for her death. Turning back to Jekiah, she assured him that none of this was his fault. Everything she did was her choice, the only choice she could make. Addressing the Commander last, she remarked she never imagined their partnership coming to an end this way. With her dying breath, she reflected on her life, the battles she won, the mistakes and enemies she made, and proudly declared she wouldn't change a thing. Jekiah, in denial of her impending death, pleaded her not to go. Shae could only speak his name before expiring.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

[[File:Shae death.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Shae Vizla dies]]
The Commander and the Ordo brothers barely had a moment to mourn before the ground violently trembled. Realizing Nul's machine was the cause, the Commander moved to find it while Rass stayed with Jekiah and Shae, planning to regroup with the other Mandalorians and take out any Hidden Chain stragglers. With the way blocked by a ray shield, the Commander resorted to moving through the ventilation system, fighting through all manner of wild creatures, while listening to comm chatter, indicating that the Hidden Chain were being routed in both space and in the fortress.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Endgame==

[[File:Malgus vs Jadus.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Malgus vs Jadus]]
Meanwhile, Malgus slaughtered his way through Jadus' followers until he reached Nul's machine. Suddenly, he is electrocuted by a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] hanging over the chamber, dropping him to his knees. He is then confronted by an illusion of Emperor [[Darth Vowrawn|Vowrawn]], mocking the mighty Sith warrior for being so easily bested, labeling him an unthinking tool meant only to serve. Rising to his feet, Malgus swift cut down the illusion before sensing Jadus approach from behind. His rival remarked he was right to destroy the Sith along with the Jedi and in doing so pave the way for a new galactic order he would rule. Malgus vented his disgust with Sith like Jadus relying on trickery and deceit and engaged him in battle, eventually managing to fell him. Retrieving Nul's holocron from Jadus' corpse and uniting it with the machine, Malgus proceeded to seat himself on it with the confidence that his plans were finally coming to fruition. The Commander arrived in the chamber soon after, having followed the trail of carnage Malgus had left. With the machine in full operation, Malgus taunted the Commander for failing to stop him, as he promised long ago. He began to monologue about how the galaxy was broken and the only way to fix it was to burn it down and build it anew.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

[[File:Vindican appears.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vindican appears]]
Suddenly, the two adversaries were thrust into a nightmare world. Malgus quickly realized that the illusion was being generated by the meditation sphere, part of a trap Jadus had set. While the Commander's gaze was distracted, Malgus suddenly vanished and in his place appeared an illusion of his former Master, [[Darth Vindican]], who warned the Commander that his apprentice was obsessed with destiny and advised them to strike Malgus down before he could betray them first. Suddenly, Malgus reappeared and cut down the illusion, and advised the Commander to ignore Vindican's words and focus on destroying the meditation sphere before they lose sight of the reality beyond. Thus, the two adversaries became temporary allies and attempted to destroy the pillars supporting the meditation sphere to no avail.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" /> 

[[File:Adraas appears.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lord Adraas returns as an illusion]]
Another illusion appeared in the form of Lord [[Adraas]], who introduced himself to the Commander as the Conqueror of Ord Redama, bane of Coruscant and the one who ended the [[Great Galactic War]] where Malgus failed to. Wanting to still his old rival's deceitful tongue, Malgus quickly cut Adraas down, labeling him as cowardly in death as he was in life, quick to bow to the whims of the Dark Council and blamed him for influencing the Empire into placating the Jedi instead of destroying them, hardening his resolve to destroy those he believed unworthy of the title of Sith. However, Malgus was so taken with the illusion that he began to view the Commander as Adraas and attack them, forcing the Commander to fight against him with the support of three illusions of Adraas until Malgus regained his senses.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

A third illusion then appeared, one more close to Malgus' heart: his former lover, [[Eleena Daru]]. Addressed by his original name, Veradun, Malgus rejected her words, saying he's not the same man she knew. As the Commander suddenly restrained by a dark power to keep them from interfering, Daru assured Malgus that his many strong traits, including his need to prove himself, is proof he is the man she loved. Malgus stated he had proven himself more times than he could count, but this situation was more. He reflected on how the Empire's intolerance keep Daru and many others from becoming a warrior and commander and rewarded with an ignominious death. Remarking he still carried the weight of the galaxy on his shoulders, Daru told him he was not responsible for the fate of the Sith. As she reached to touch his face, Malgus hardened himself and declared that power should not go unwielded and once he succeeded it never will be and expressed his wish that Daru could see. He then held up his lightsaber and stabbed Daru through the chest, causing her to radiate with a dark aura, before gently laying her on the ground. At that same the moment, the Commander was freed from the dark hold.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Meanwhile, the Republic fleet started detecting a huge spike in power from inside the fortress, which Sal-Deron suspected was Nul's machine. Desperate to stop Malgus, Rava ordered the fleet to target the fortress for bombardment. Peralun and Beniko warned him not to go through with it, as it would be a mistake they wouldn't recover from. Nonetheless, Rans agreed with Sal-Deron's counsel and ordered Rava to proceed. In response, Beniko warned everyone over comms about the impending bombardment.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

[[File:Jadus vs Malgus and Commander.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Jadus prepares to fight Malgus and the Commander]]
Fortunately, Beniko's warning was heard by the Commander, which Malgus saw as a sign they were breaking through the illusions. Suddenly, the two were confronted by a very much alive Jadus. Malgus tried to cut him down only for Jadus to reappear behind them, mocking Malgus for thinking himself worthy of Nul's machine. Both the Commander and Malgus concluded that Jadus was in fact inside the meditation sphere. Jadus then revealed he had upgraded the machine, not only to reveal people's connection to the Force, but to expose how they would be hunted down, using the chaos to bring the awakened under his sway. Drawing power from the meditation sphere, Jadus proclaimed he would sacrifice both the Commander and Malgus to amplify his words across the galaxy and engaged his adversaries in another fight. During the fight, Jaduss mocked Malgus for performing what he had always done - serving another, one more worthy. Malgus rejected his words, proclaiming he had no Master, that he was free. Jadus then created another illusion of Vindican, mocking Malgus' obsession with destiny and where his path had taken him. Malgus defiantly proclaimed he could see the truth and reminded he was already free of his former Master.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

[[File:Malgus uses machine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Malgus uses Darth Nul's machine]]
Ultimately, Malgus stabbed Jadus through the chest, causing him to wake in his real body, and ordered his rival to flee and prepare for what was to come. Jadus confidently stated he was already prepared and piloted the meditation sphere out of the cavern. As the Commander stated they couldn't let him get away, suddenly they returned to reality with Malgus still seated on Nul's machine. Wasting no time, Malgus began to speak through the Force, reaching planets such as Odessen, [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], his message directed at individuals who had either forgotten or were unaware of their connection to the Force. Sal-Deron was among those who heard his message and warned her allies, forcing Rava to order the bombardment. Even as the cavern began to collapse, Malgus encouraged those who could hear him to tear down the institutions that had shackled them and declared them unworthy of powers until the strongest remained to claim the galaxy.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Khar Shian first appeared in Game Update 7.9: ''Legacy Reborn'', released on [[June 2]], [[2026]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260602-0|text=Game Update 7.9 "Legacy Reborn" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

All saboteur players, upon meeting with the faction leadership, will have their double agent role exposed by their original faction after receiving credible evidence off-screen.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

If [[Theron Shan]] was left to die at the end of the Fractured Alliances storyline, then [[T7-O1]] will take his place throughout the story.<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

When the player confronts Malgus, they have three dialogue options:
*Allow Malgus to continue.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
*The light side dialogue has the player refusing to let Malgus succeed. They acknowledge he may be right about the Jedi and Sith having too much control, but denounces his plan as chaos.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
*The dark side dialogue has the player declaring themself more worthy of Nul's machine than Malgus and vows to see to it that he doesn't live see the galaxy he dreams of or the one the player would create.

At the end of the mission, the player can choose to either protect Malgus from falling debris or penetrate the energy field surrounding him to ready a killing blow, though the scene fades to black for the latter choice and leaving its outcome unknown.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

===Imperial Storyline===
For Imperial players, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] partakes in the battle with [[Darth Acina|Acina]], or [[Darth Vowrawn|Vowrawn]] depending on the player's choice in ''War for Iokath'' storyline, [[Darth Krovos]], [[Darth Xarion]], [[Anri|Major Anri]], and [[Maiya Vix]] leading the Empire's forces consisting of seven [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]] and eight [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]].<ref name="Into the Shadows" />

Later Krovos and Anri, aboard the ''[[Stygian Talon]]'', a [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]], and lead the attack against the [[Hidden Chain]] fleet and prevent their ground forces from following the [[Eternal Alliance]] and the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]].<ref name="Into the Shadows" /><ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The First Hurdle|Khar Shian}}</ref>
